entities.summary: "Forever" is a song performed by Ukrainian singer Alekseev. It was originally released as "Navsegda" on 10 November 2017. It represented Belarus in the Eurovision Song Contest 2018. The song was released as a digital download on 10 January 2018 through Zion Music.
